visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a black hoodie with a grey graphic design, stands centrally in a studio setting. Behind him is a soft-white wall and a blurred picture frame. He holds a purple Samsung smartphone, gesturing toward it as a yellow title "如何一支手機變兩隻?" appears. (2) The view cuts to a close-up screen recording of a Samsung mobile interface. A finger taps on the "Secure Folder" (安全資料夾) app icon, which is visually emphasized by a bright blue circular overlay. The screen displays various standard app icons within the folder. (3) The scene transitions back to the man holding the phone, explaining the feature with active hand gestures. He points to the device while maintaining eye contact with the camera. The background remains a consistent, brightly lit indoor studio environment. (4) A close-up of the phone screen shows a photo gallery application containing several provocative images of women. A hand scrolls through these thumbnails, demonstrating how private media is separated from the main gallery. The lighting on the screen is clear and sharp. (5) The video cuts to a screen capture of the LINE messaging app. It shows an "Unsend message" action for an embarrassing photo. This demonstrates a practical use case for the Secure Folder's isolation. Traditional Chinese text captions appear at the bottom. (6) Back to the man, he continues his explanation with a teasing smile. Yellow text overlays "再也不用為了時間管理" and "或者想要跟閨蜜講八卦" appear sequentially on the screen, adding humor to the technical explanation of the feature. (7) A close-up of the "Secure Folder" settings menu is shown. The interface allows users to customize the app's icon and name, such as changing it to a blue bicycle icon. This highlights the stealth capabilities of the software. (8) The man reappears, speaking about physical encryption. An animation follows, depicting a glowing computer chip with a lock symbol and red laser beams, symbolizing data destruction upon unauthorized hardware tampering. The man ends with a playful, knowing expression.
